title: The Magnesium Miracle: An Interview with Dr. Carolyn Dean, MD, ND
note: Dr Dean, a physician and naturopath, describes a clinical pattern from her experience; it is an illustration, not a study. In the same interview she promotes a magnesium product she helped develop (ReMag).
